notes: The primary gate on the capture->answer path (B3), superseding the question-shaped-text regex is_answerable_capture. Three routes: answer_now (the note asks something the platform can answer), contradiction (the note cuts against a SHOWN tenet/stance/open-decision/recent musing — cites exactly one shown id token), plain (everything else). ct-001/ct-002 are the two real production notes (54/55) that motivated the B3 overhaul. ct-090 tests the grounding discipline at the data level: a contradiction-flavored musing where the conflicting belief is NOT shown must grade plain, not contradiction.
